approve_label_blank.statement: The Approve button had no text on it (only the 'Approve:' label next to it)

closed_by_itself.statement: The HUD closed by itself when I chose menu item 2

hud_appeared.statement: The HUD appeared by itself a few seconds after menu item 1

last_click_shown.statement: The 'Last click' line named each button right after I clicked it

picks_enabled_after_approve.statement: After I clicked Approve, Pick B looked normal and I could click it

picks_greyed.statement: Pick A, Pick B and Pick C looked greyed out until I clicked Approve

stage_updated.statement: The Stage and Deltas lines changed every second, also while I clicked

run.opened_from: the S8 loop task (started by the init script), as the bridge task would open it
